description_en: Queries the list of enterprise travel standards (including categories such as domestic flights, international flights, train tickets, and hotels)
description_zh: 查询企业差旅标准列表（包括机票、国际机票、火车票、酒店等类目）
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen travel-standard-list-query --from-group false --rule-name '普通员工规则' --page-no 1 --page-size 10 --x-acs-btrip-corp-token feth00jqwls --user-id user_1234 --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TravelStandardListQuery

parameters.help_en: Applicable to parent-subsidiary enterprises. Set this parameter to true to query the unified group travel standards. If left empty, the system returns the travel rules that are currently in effect for the enterprise
parameters.help_zh: 主子企业适用：若需查询集团统一差旅标准，则在此指定为true，为空则返回当前企业实际生效的差旅规则列表
parameters.name: from_group

parameters.help_en: The name of the travel standard to search for
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: A header parameter obtained from the "Enterprise Access Credential" operation. Add it to the request header. In HTTP mode, you can use corp_token=value in the URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh: header参数,由“企业访问凭证”接口获取（添加在header里）,http模式可以在链接中使用corp_token=value来替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_corp_token

parameters.help_en: The user ID. Specify this parameter when querying the travel standard bound to an employee
parameters.help_zh: 查询员工绑定差标时使用
parameters.name: user_id
